source_text: Recapitulatio spiritalis: nigredo paenitentiae et certaminis; formositas imaginis Dei; sol persecutionis; filii matris persecutores ex gente; vineae ecclesiae; meridies perfecta cognitio; cognitio sui; haedi iniqui; equitatus ecclesiae contra Pharaonem; myrrha passionis; cyprus unguenti Spiritus; oculi columbae; cubile corporis fructuosi.
pass_a_gloss: Recapitulation spiritual: blackness of-penitence and of-struggle; beauty of-image of-God...
pass_b_english: Spiritual recapitulation: blackness of penitence and struggle; beauty of God’s image; sun of persecution; mother’s sons as persecutors from the race; vineyards as churches; noon as perfect knowledge; self-knowledge; goats as the wicked; cavalry of the church against Pharaoh; myrrh of the passion; henna of the Spirit’s ointment; dove-eyes; the couch of a fruitful body.
